sql: SELECT organization_id, name, raw_identifier, scheme, country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM organization_mentions WHERE organization_id IN (31562628,31607602,31562686,31645298,31611304,31622550,30914487,31591848,31600847,31612560,31618870,31562625,31594838,31600628) GROUP BY organization_id, name, raw_identifier, scheme, country LIMIT 300

sql: SELECT m.organization_id, m.notice_id, m.name, m.raw_identifier, n.published_at FROM organization_mentions m JOIN notices n ON n.id = m.notice_id WHERE m.organization_id IN (31591848,31622550,31611304) LIMIT 20
